vendor.name: Adobe Target
vendor.notes: Adobe Target — A/B testing + personalization. Reads visitor ID for segment membership.

findings.notes: Observed firing in the opted-out scan under a non-definitive methodology (the opt-out could not be confirmed). Re-run with a recognised CMP or banner-click methodology to confirm. Adobe Target fired tracking in opted-out consent state (no consent mode). Advanced Consent Mode does not apply to non-Google vendors — they must be fully blocked when consent is denied, not converted to cookieless pings. Tag needs a consent gate in GTM or removal.

vendor.name: Adobe Analytics
vendor.notes: Adobe Analytics (formerly SiteCatalyst). Visit ID cookies (s_vi, s_ecid) are persistent identifiers shared across the Adobe Marketing Cloud. Frequently invisible in CCPA opt-out implementations because the consent module is configured separately from CMP. Pre-consent firing surfaces in pixel-as-sale enforcement (Sephora theory extends here).

enforcement_themes.label: Vendor and third-party governance
evidence: 2 inventory row(s) likely require sale/sharing review
enforcement_themes.regulatory_context: California enforcement has treated missing or overbroad ad-tech contract terms as a primary violation, not just a paperwork issue.
enforcement_themes.recommended_action: Confirm each ad-tech, analytics, and pixel vendor has purpose-limited contract terms and is classified in the tracking inventory.

enforcement_themes.label: Sensitive data / purpose limitation
enforcement_themes.regulatory_context: Healthline and GM show that regulators are applying purpose limitation to sensitive page context, location, driving, and other service data reused for advertising or data-broker purposes.
enforcement_themes.recommended_action: Block advertising and behavioral tracking on sensitive-context pages unless a specific consent and purpose basis exists.

enforcement_themes.label: Tracking technology inventory
enforcement_themes.regulatory_context: Recent orders require current inventories of tracking technologies and periodic scanning to catch drift.
enforcement_themes.recommended_action: Review and export this inventory quarterly and after every tag release.
